properties.name: gibraltar_strait
properties.description: Technical reference corridor for the GFW pipev3 -> pipev4 break test. Strait of Gibraltar, the narrowest east-west commercial transit between the Atlantic and the Mediterranean.
properties.purpose: Test whether the AIS-SAR matching rate also jumps at 2026-03-01 in an unrelated corridor. NOT a causal control for the Hormuz disruption.
